name: @red-cup-engineering/exchange-google-callback-service
description: Turn Google's authorization-code callback (the `code` query parameter) plus Google client config (googleClientId, googleClientSecret, publicBaseUrl) into the verified identity claims (email, emailVerified) from Google's id_token. Use it at the GET /oauth/google/callback resource, after looking up the pending authorization by state and before judging admission (see judge-principal-admission-service).
